steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: inset-room-to-polygon
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const room=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>!r.external)||st.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const ok=st.insetRoom(room.id, 0.3); window.__store.getState().setPlanSelection({type:'room', id:room.id}); const r2=window.__store.getState().floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id===room.id); return JSON.stringify({room:room.id, inset:ok, verts: r2&&r2.polygon&&r2.polygon.length}); })()

steps.name: select-polygon-room
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const r=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>x.polygon&&x.polygon.length>=3); if(!r) return 'no-poly-room'; st.setPlanSelection({type:'room', id:r.id}); return JSON.stringify({id:r.id, verts:r.polygon.length}); })()
